02 · Services

Strategy

A clear, measurable content plan aligned with your goals.

Beautiful communication without strategy is just noise. I start from your goals, your audience and what your competitors are doing to build a content plan that makes sense and can be measured.

The work also covers visibility in search engines and in AI-generated answers. Clear, structured, quotable content is already an advantage.

What you get

What you get

  • SEO and GEO strategy
  • Web and search engine visibility
  • Visual harmonisation and consistency
  • Caption writing and storytelling
  • Ongoing competitor and digital monitoring
  • Use of digital trends

Process

How we move forward.

  1. 01

    Audit

    We look at what exists, what works and what is missing.

  2. 02

    Framing

    Goals, audience, promise, tone and metrics to track.

  3. 03

    Plan

    Editorial line, content pillars, rhythm and formats.

  4. 04

    Measure

    Reading the numbers, adjusting and deciding what comes next.
